drafts.name: open-effect-docs
drafts.source:
// Drafted by Smithers from a prompt. In this form it runs on your device; other code needs a sandbox.
import { AgentAction } from "@smthrs/agent"
import { Flow } from "@smthrs/flow"
import { Schema } from "effect"

/** What the agent does each time the flow runs. */
const instructions = [
  "This flow takes no input and does exactly one thing: open the Effect documentation for the person.",
  "",
  "1. Call app/web/open with the URL https://effect.website/docs and mode \"embed\". This is the exact Effect docs page to open; do not substitute any other URL, and do not call any other flow while drafting, opening, or confirming it.",
  "",
  "2. Handle the answer by its shown field:",
  "   - shown \"page\": the docs are now rendered inside the chat, with their origin above the page. Say briefly in one line that the Effect docs are open in the chat.",
  "   - shown \"card\": the site refused to be embedded (framing \"refused\") or could not be checked (framing \"unknown\"), so a card with an Open in new tab button was added instead. Say that you added a card that opens https://effect.website/docs in a new tab. Never say or imply that the page is shown in the chat in this case.",
  "",
  "3. Stop. Do nothing else: no input parsing, no other flow, no app navigation, no theme change, no file or repository work. The flow is complete once the answer to app/web/open has been reported.",
].join("\n")

/** The flow's one step: the agent follows the instructions with the run's input. */
const Agent = AgentAction.make("open-effect-docs/agent", {
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  output: Schema.String,
  seat: "agent",
  prompt: ({ input }) => (input === "" ? instructions : `${instructions}\n\nInput: ${input}`),
})

export default Flow.make("open-effect-docs", {
  description: "Opens the Effect documentation page at https://effect.website/docs, embedded in the chat, taking no input and doing nothing else.",
  capabilities: [],
  flows: ["app/web/open"],
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  success: Schema.String,
  error: Agent.errorSchema,
  body: ({ input }) => Agent.call({ input }),
})
